comparison.objective: Secure an installed clevis pin by bending the cotter-pin legs to opposite sides.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply localized non-prehensile force to plastically bend two small legs without rebending them.
comparison.success_condition: Both legs remain at least 60 degrees on opposite sides, still and clear for one second; significant rebending zeros the trial.
comparison.reason: Permanent plastic deformation of a split pin is different from reversible screw adjustment, locknut tightening, and cyclic retention testing.
